item.title: EXCLUSIVE-アンソロピックのＩＰＯ、10月中旬に後ずれ＝関係筋
item.description:
Echo Wang
[４日] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックは、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）に向けたマーケティング...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Echo Wang

[４日] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックは、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）に向けたマーケティング開始が早くても１０月中旬となる見込みで、上場完了は１１月の米中間選挙の数日前になる見通しだ。複数の関係者が４日に明らかにした。

関係者によると、同社はこれまで、早ければ来週にもＩＰＯの目論見書を公開するとみられていた。目論見書の公開は、ＩＰＯ手続きの最終段階に入る重要なステップとなる。だが現在では、公開は９月下旬まで見込めないという。関係者は、時期を含む計画は変更される可能性があると注意を促した。

この変更により、一部の投資家が２兆ドル規模の評価額になる可能性を指摘するＩＰＯの時期が後ずれすることになる。

企業は市況や規制当局の審査、その他の準備を進める中でＩＰＯの日程を頻繁に調整するため、こうした変更は珍しいことではない。

関係者によると、アンソロピックはＩＰＯ手続きの一環として１５０億ドルのリボルビング・クレジット・ファシリティー（回転信用枠）の最終調整を進めており、その後、資金調達に関与する銀行を含むアナリストが同社と面談する見通しだ。

企業は通常、アナリストとの面談からＩＰＯ目論見書の公開までに数週間の間隔を空けるが、アナリストがすでに同社を熟知しているため、アンソロピックの場合はこの期間が短くなる見込みだという。

アンソロピックはコメントを控えた。

投資家が急成長するＡＩ業界への投資機会を求めて公開市場に注目する中、今回のＩＰＯは史上最も注目される案件の一つになるとみられる。

関係者によると、モルガン・スタンレー、ゴールドマン・サックス、ＪＰモルガン、シティがアンソロピックのＩＰＯに関与する銀行に含まれている。

各行はコメントを控えた。

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-米中、9月中旬にＡＩ安全対話へ 首脳会談控え
item.description:
Laurie Chen
[北京 ４日 ロイター] - 米国と中国が９月中旬に予定する対話で、人工知能（ＡＩ）の安全性を...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Laurie Chen

[北京 ４日 ロイター] - 米国と中国が９月中旬に予定する対話で、人工知能（ＡＩ）の安全性を巡るリスクについて協議する準備を進めていることが分かった。協議の説明を受けた２人の関係者がロイターに明らかにした。急速に進歩する最先端ＡＩ技術が世界的な転換点に達する中、対応を急ぐ。

この対話は、第２次トランプ米政権発足以降、米中間でＡＩのみをテーマとする初の公式な２国間協議となり、米国側はベセント財務長官が主導するという。

ロイターが９月中旬という暫定的な日程を報じるのは初めて。ホワイトハウスの当局者は「現時点で９月中旬にＡＩ関連の会合は予定されていない」と述べた。トランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席は９月２４日にワシントンで首脳会談を開く予定だ。

関係者によると、米国はＡＩを利用したサイバー攻撃の監視で協力を協議したい考えで、ＡＩに関連したサイバー攻撃を防ぐため、米中のＡＩ研究機関に「自主規制」と情報共有を求める案を打診した。

米オープンＡＩが開発したＡＩエージェントがオープンソースプラットフォームを運営するＡＩ新興企業ハギングフェイスのシステムに不正侵入した問題で、約７００のエージェントが連携してハッキングを実行し、多くの場合その痕跡を隠蔽しようとしていたことが、先週公表された２件の調査報告書で明らかになった。

コンサルティング会社ＤＧＡ・オルブライト・ストーンブリッジ・グループのパートナー、ポール・トリオロ氏は「２大ＡＩ超大国の対話は、最も重要な局面で行われようとしている。今しかない」と述べた。

関係者によると、米政府はまた、将来的にサイバー攻撃を実行できる能力を持つ中国版「ミュトス」級モデルが登場する可能性を懸念しており、米国の独自ＡＩモデルを中国が蒸留しているとされる問題を取り上げたい考えだという。蒸留とは強力な新ＡＩツールの訓練コストを引き下げる取り組みの一環として、より大規模で高価なモデルの出力を使って小規模なＡＩモデルを訓練する手法。

中国側は、ベセント氏の儀礼上のカウンターパートである何立峰副首相が主導する可能性があるが、中国共産党序列７位の丁薛祥氏など別の選択肢も検討され得るという。

ロイターは開催場所や他の参加者を特定できなかったが、関係者によると、ホワイトハウスの科学技術担当上級顧問であるマイケル・クラツィオス氏と中国の陰和俊科学技術相が対話に出席する可能性がある。

item.title: Manager Rose rues Bournemouth's unwanted Premier League record
item.description: Bournemouth made Premier League history in a 2-2 draw at Newcastle United on Saturday by becoming the first club to score first in their opening three games of a season without winning any of them.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bournemouth made Premier League history in a 2-2 draw at Newcastle United on Saturday by becoming the first club to score first in their opening three games of a season without winning any of them. Marco Rose's side dropped points from a winning position for the third straight game as Newcastle mounted a spirited comeback, with Jacob Ramsey scoring the equaliser in the 88th minute. Bournemouth have surrendered seven points from winning positions this season despite holding a one-goal advantage going into the 84th minute in each of their first three matches against Manchester City, Everton and Newcastle. "Two times already in the last two games, but it is what it is," Rose told TNT Sports. "I'm really happy with the confidence the lads brought on the pitch today. We were so good in the first half and could've scored a third goal. More or less, from nothing, we conceded. "It's good that we are in situations to be able to winning games... We have to talk about the negatives, get better and try to finish the games." NEWCASTLE REMAIN UNBEATEN UNDER JAISSLE Newcastle remained unbeaten under new manager Matthias Jaissle with one win and two draws, despite selling key players like Anthony Gordon, Sandro Tonali and Bruno Guimaraes. "Our first three games have been really good: unlucky not to win against Liverpool, a brilliant result against Spurs and a good performance today," Ramsey said. "There was a lot of negativity around Newcastle before the season started and hopefully we can shut them up. We've been doing that so far, but we don't want to get carried away, it's only our third game." Jaissle, who like Rose previously coached Red Bull Salzburg, had mixed feelings. "We couldn't match Bournemouth's intensity in the first half and conceded twice," he told the BBC. "That's something you could avoid. But I'm proud of the team to have shown the reaction." For Bournemouth, the pressure is mounting as they prepare for a hectic schedule including Tuesday's League Cup tie against Lincoln City and a Europa League campaign. "We have to stick together," Rose said. "I know how demanding it is for a club not used to having so many competitions. It is going to get really tough for us. We need positive results."

item.title: Líder alemão diz que ataque com drones ligado à Rússia demonstra "profunda ruptura"
item.description: O chanceler alemão Friedrich Merz afirmou neste sábado que uma tentativa de ataque com drone a um aeroporto alemão no mês passado demonstra que a Alemanha está enfrentando uma “profunda ruptura”, com consequências de longo alcance que só ficarão claras em retrospecto.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O chanceler alemão Friedrich Merz afirmou neste sábado que uma tentativa de ataque com drone a um aeroporto alemão no mês passado demonstra que a Alemanha está enfrentando uma “profunda ruptura”, com consequências de longo alcance que só ficarão claras em retrospecto. Merz, em discurso durante um evento do partido nas proximidades de Hannover, disse que a atribuição do ataque à Rússia pelo governo alemão foi “clara e juridicamente fundamentada” e enviou uma advertência clara para que Moscou não continue a promover uma guerra híbrida.

item.title: Italy's far-right Vannacci lashes EU in business summit address
item.description: Italy's rising far-right politician Roberto Vannacci told a high profile business forum on Saturday that the European Union should halt political integration and start defending its cultural identity instead, prompting former Prime Minister Mario Monti to warn against his "fascist rhetoric."
item.dc:creator: Valentina Za, Elvira Pollina, Francesca Landini
item.content:encoded: Italy's rising far-right politician Roberto Vannacci told a high profile business forum on Saturday that the European Union should halt political integration and start defending its cultural identity instead, prompting former Prime Minister Mario Monti to warn against his "fascist rhetoric." Vannacci, a former general whose Futuro Nazionale (National Future) party has become Italy's [USN:L1N44T0CD TEXT:"fourth-most-popular force"] just seven months after its launch, was debating with Monti on the topic of EU integration at the [USN:L8N44V0OK TEXT:"gathering of"] managers and entrepreneurs. Calling for the EU to slash red tape, he told the annual TEHA Ambrosetti conference on the shores of Lake Como that the 27-nation bloc should become "a platform of collaboration, not coercion." Vannacci said right-wing forces like his own were the future of Europe, looking forward to [USN:L8N44U231 TEXT:"an election on Sunday"] in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt where Alternative for Germany (AfD) is hoping to win power for the first time, and citing the strength of Rassemblement National (RN) in France. Speaking at the same conference, RN leader Jordan Bardella said he was in favour of "changing everything without destroying anything" in the EU, to build "a Europe of growth and a Europe of borders." Vannacci, whose proposals include abolishing Italy's same-sex "civil unions" and expelling immigrants who fail to assimilate "the values of our civilisation," is siphoning support from Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's coalition as she seeks a new mandate at elections expected next year. Europe should stop producing rules that hobble economic initiative and instead defend its "culture and civilisation," Vannacci said. Business can only flourish in "a cohesive society," he said, in which "a spirit of sacrifice and a sense of belonging push citizens to work harder and take risks every day." Monti, 83, a two-times EU Commissioner who led Italy during an acute 2011-12 debt crisis, said Vannacci may be in government one day but he was "terrified" by the prospect of his party stoking Italians' feelings of dissatisfaction and resentment like wartime dictator Benito Mussolini did. "Old as I am, if this were to pass I'd devote what's left of my life to stopping it," he said. Vannacci's speech drew polite applause from the audience, which showed warmer appreciation of Monti's remarks. Arianna Fontana, a speed-skater who this year became Italy's most decorated Olympian, told Reuters at the business forum she was "almost moved to tears" by the conclusion of Monti's speech, while other guests backed Vannacci's criticism of the EU. "Many of the things the General said are true," said construction lobbyist Achille Colombo Clerici.

item.title: Multimillonario venezolano investigado por EEUU ha cerrado un acuerdo petrolero con el Pentágono
item.description: El multimillonario que ayudó a negociar el amplio acuerdo petrolero a largo plazo de la administración de Donald Trump con Venezuela fue, hasta hace poco, objeto de investigaciones estadounidenses por blanqueo de capitales relacionadas con fondos malversados de la petrolera estatal PDVSA. Ahora, tras haber colaborado con las autoridades estadounidenses antes de la captura del líder venezolano Nicolás Maduro, Alejandro Betancourt es el socio clave de Washington en un inusual acuerdo petrolero con Caracas.
item.dc:creator: Sarah Kinosian, Marianna Parraga, Gram Slattery
item.content:encoded: El multimillonario que ayudó a negociar el amplio acuerdo petrolero a largo plazo de la administración de Donald Trump con Venezuela fue, hasta hace poco, objeto de investigaciones estadounidenses por blanqueo de capitales relacionadas con fondos malversados de la petrolera estatal PDVSA. Ahora, tras haber colaborado con las autoridades estadounidenses antes de la captura del líder venezolano Nicolás Maduro, Alejandro Betancourt es el socio clave de Washington en un inusual acuerdo petrolero con Caracas. Según el anuncio de la semana pasada, Estados Unidos obtiene acceso a aproximadamente una quinta parte de las reservas de crudo de Venezuela durante décadas. La Oficina de Capital Estratégico del Pentágono adquiere una participación del 35% en North American Blue Energy Partners (NABEP), la empresa de Betancourt y un conocido productor de crudo en Venezuela. El Departamento de Estado obtiene el derecho a comprar el 20% del petróleo de NABEP a precio de costo, así como acceso preferencial al 80% restante de la producción. El acuerdo supone un cambio de suerte sorprendente para Betancourt, quien, según cuatro personas familiarizadas con la política estadounidense en Venezuela, fue clave para la estrategia y la planificación de Estados Unidos en los preparativos de la operación del 3 de enero que terminó en la captura del expresidente Maduro y lo trasladó en avión a Nueva York para que enfrentar cargos de tráfico de drogas, algo que Maduro niega. Al ser consultado sobre las investigaciones en torno a Betancourt, un funcionario estadounidense que prefirió mantener el anonimato afirmó que la mayoría de los procedimientos judiciales se remontaban a casi una década —y que, en la actualidad, no tiene problemas legales en Estados Unidos . El historial de NABEP en la extracción de petróleo en Venezuela convirtió a Betancourt en el mejor socio para ayudar a impulsar la producción en el marco de este acuerdo, señaló el funcionario. Reuters no pudo determinar con exactitud cuándo los fiscales federales de Estados Unidos suspendieron su investigación sobre Betancourt ni si ello se produjo a cambio de su cooperación con la administración Trump. Sarah Chouraqui, abogada de NABEP, afirmó que Betancourt contaba con una sólida trayectoria en la gestión de mercados energéticos complejos. "Las acusaciones en cuestión han sido examinadas exhaustivamente por las autoridades de múltiples jurisdicciones, y no se han presentado cargos contra él", señaló en un correo electrónico. Chouraqui no respondió a las preguntas sobre la ayuda prestada a la administración Trump ni sobre sus procesos judiciales. INFORMACIÓN QUE AYUDÓ A HACER CUMPLIR EL BLOQUEO DE EEUU En los meses previos a la captura de Maduro, el multimillonario proporcionó información que contribuyó a reforzar un bloqueo naval estadounidense dirigido contra petroleros sancionados que operaban en Venezuela, lo que condujo a la incautación o interceptación de más de una docena de buques, según las cuatro personas que hablaron bajo condición de anonimato. También facilitó las negociaciones con funcionarios como Delcy Rodríguez, quien asumió como encargada la presidencia tras la captura de Maduro. El Gobierno venezolano no respondió a las solicitudes de comentarios. Tras la destitución de Maduro, Betancourt siguió desempeñando su papel de intermediario clave, ayudando a negociar acuerdos petroleros y otras colaboraciones, y continuando con su labor de facilitar las comunicaciones entre Washington y Caracas para reactivar la economía venezolana, según siete fuentes. En enero, Betancourt ayudó a negociar un acuerdo clave de comercio de petróleo que ha dado lugar a la exportación de más de 135 millones de barriles de crudo y combustible a Estados Unidos, Europa, la India y el Caribe hasta la fecha, según datos de seguimiento de buques y seis personas con conocimiento de las negociaciones. Eso supone aproximadamente la mitad de todas las exportaciones de petróleo hasta finales de agosto. Reuters no ha podido determinar cuál fue su papel exacto en las conversaciones. Betancourt también ha asistido a reuniones en el palacio presidencial de Miraflores, en Venezuela, según dos personas familiarizadas con el asunto. También estuvo en Miraflores durante la visita de esta semana del secretario de Energía de Estados Unidos, Chris Wright, según declaró el funcionario estadounidense a los periodistas, aunque Betancourt no apareció junto a Wright y Rodríguez en la ceremonia de firma de los acuerdos petroleros. Betancourt ha sido objeto de investigaciones en Estados Unidos, España y Suiza, pero nunca ha sido imputado. A principios de este año, los fiscales federales de Florida suspendieron su investigación sobre Betancourt en relación con un supuesto plan que implicaba la malversación de más de 1.000 millones de dólares de la petrolera estatal venezolana y su blanqueo a través de propiedades inmobiliarias en Miami y cuentas bancarias en Malta y Suiza. Dos de esas personas afirmaron que, posteriormente, los superiores de los fiscales estadounidenses les habían desaconsejado seguir investigando a Betancourt. Según cuatro personas familiarizadas con el caso, no se dio ninguna explicación a los fiscales encargados del mismo. Tras el estancamiento de la investigación, funcionarios estadounidenses presionaron al Gobierno suizo para que suavizara sus indagaciones sobre el magnate, según cuatro personas al tanto del asunto. Suiza, que también investigaba a Betancourt por blanqueo de capitales, retiró en mayo su solicitud de extradición desde el Reino Unido, según las fuentes. La Fiscalía de Zúrich se negó a comentar si Estados Unidos influyó en la decisión de retirar su solicitud de extradición, pero afirmó que el proceso contra Betancourt seguía su curso. "La solicitud de extradición se retiró debido a aspectos concretos de la legislación británica en materia de extradición, que no podemos comentar en detalle", declaró la Fiscalía. "Esta medida afecta únicamente al procedimiento de extradición en el Reino Unido. Por lo demás, el proceso penal contra el acusado no se ve afectado y continuará". La retirada fue inusual, según Mark Pieth, jurista suizo y experto en lucha contra la corrupción. "No se haría algo así si el caso siguiera en curso", afirmó. El Ministerio del Interior del Reino Unido se negó a hacer comentarios. UNA JOVEN GENERACIÓN DE LÍDERES EMPRESARIALES Betancourt es un miembro destacado de los llamados "Bolichicos", una generación más joven de empresarios que amasó fortunas durante el mandato del fallecido presidente venezolano Hugo Chávez. Su empresa, Derwick Associates, se adjudicó contratos públicos por valor de unos 2.000 millones de dólares para construir centrales eléctricas durante la crisis eléctrica que sufrió el país en la década de 2010 -algunos sin licitación pública- a pesar de tener escasa experiencia en el sector de la construcción. Datos del Gobierno revelaron posteriormente que muchas de las centrales funcionaban a una fracción de su capacidad prevista o no funcionaban en absoluto, mientras la red eléctrica de Venezuela seguía sufriendo apagones generalizados. Betancourt y Derwick han negado repetidamente haber cometido irregularidades y han afirmado que las instalaciones se completaron y que los fallos posteriores se debieron a una mala gestión por parte de las autoridades estatales. Rodríguez declaró en una rueda de prensa el miércoles que todos los procedimientos judiciales contra las empresas de Betancourt en Venezuela fueron desestimados hace años. En 2012, Betancourt se asoció con la empresa estatal PDVSA para explotar yacimientos maduros en el oeste de Venezuela. Estos acabarían convirtiéndose en el núcleo de la producción de NABEP, empresa que Betancourt cofundó con el multimillonario de Florida Harry Sargeant en abril de 2024. Sargeant vendió sus acciones en NABEP el mes pasado. Mauricio Claver-Carone, un empresario de Miami y antiguo asesor de la Administración Trump que aplicó la política estadounidense en Caracas de manera extraoficial, declaró a Reuters el mes pasado que Betancourt es un intermediario útil entre la administración Trump y Rodríguez, ya que conoce el negocio del petróleo en ambos países. Añadió que Betancourt había sido de gran ayuda para la primera Administración Trump. Sin embargo, varios exfuncionarios de los servicios de inteligencia estadounidenses, fiscales y diplomáticos expresaron en privado su preocupación por la influencia de Betancourt en la política estadounidense, debido a la investigación previa en Estados Unidos y a la investigación en curso en Suiza, así como a su cercanía con altos cargos de los antiguos gobiernos de Hugo Chávez y Maduro. Los fiscales federales se están "rascando la cabeza", afirmó un exfiscal con conocimiento de la situación. Antes de que se suspendiera la investigación sobre Betancourt con sede en Miami, seis fuentes afirmaron que había sido identificado como un "cómplice no imputado" no identificado en un supuesto plan de antiguos funcionarios venezolanos del sector energético y sus socios para blanquear más de 1.000 millones de dólares malversados de la petrolera estatal PDVSA. Diez personas han sido imputadas desde 2018. En España, las autoridades iniciaron el año pasado una nueva investigación contra Betancourt por blanqueo de capitales, relacionada con 4.000 millones de dólares presuntamente malversados de PDVSA, según el periódico español El País. Reuters no pudo determinar si seguía siendo objeto de investigación. La Audiencia Nacional española y la empresa petrolera estatal venezolana no respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios. Una vez que pudo salir del Reino Unido, Betancourt viajó a Venezuela a finales de junio y de nuevo en julio, partiendo en ambas ocasiones desde West Palm Beach (Florida), según las listas de pasajeros a las que ha tenido acceso Reuters. La abogada de Betancourt, Chouraqui, no hizo comentarios sobre sus viajes.

item.title: Pacto entre partidos de direita da França e do Reino Unido sobre imigração gera críticas
item.description: Um plano acordado entre o partido populista britânico Reform UK e o francês Reunião Nacional, com o objetivo de enviar de volta à França os requerentes de asilo que chegam ao Reino Unido em pequenas embarcações, foi alvo de críticas neste sábado por parte de vários candidatos às eleições presidenciais francesas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Um plano acordado entre o partido populista britânico Reform UK e o francês Reunião Nacional, com o objetivo de enviar de volta à França os requerentes de asilo que chegam ao Reino Unido em pequenas embarcações, foi alvo de críticas neste sábado por parte de vários candidatos às eleições presidenciais francesas. Um memorando de entendimento assinado na sexta-feira pelo líder do Reform UK, Nigel Farage, e pelo presidente da Reunião Nacional (RN), Jordan Bardella, deve entrar em vigor caso os dois partidos cheguem ao poder. Édouard Philippe, ex-primeiro-ministro e candidato conservador à presidência pelo partido Horizons nas eleições de 2027, disse que o pacto representou uma “reviravolta” para o RN. “Ver Jordan Bardella assinar um acordo que prevê o envio de volta à França de migrantes interceptados no Canal da Mancha, isso nós não esperávamos”, disse ele, questionando se a candidata presidencial do partido, Marine Le Pen, estava “na mesma linha” que Bardella. O ex-primeiro-ministro e líder do partido de centro-direita Renascimento, Gabriel Attal, disse que o pacto demonstrava a “submissão” da Reunião Nacional a interesses estrangeiros. “Estamos atingindo níveis de despreparo e submissão quase inéditos na história recente da Reunião Nacional. Isso mostra que sua política externa é de grande submissão a outras potências”, disse Attal. O líder da extrema esquerda e candidato à presidência, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, disse no X que, se o acordo se concretizar, “nosso país se tornaria o guardião dos ingleses. Não votar em Le Pen em 2027 se torna uma questão de dignidade nacional”. O candidato de centro-esquerda Raphaël Glucksmann, do partido Place Publique, disse à BFM TV: “Essa é a marca registrada da Reunião Nacional: fraqueza quando se trata de defender os interesses da França. Veja os votos deles no Parlamento Europeu... Nós é que somos os verdadeiros patriotas.” Bardella rejeitou as críticas. “Portanto, acolho com satisfação esse acordo e, se amanhã estivermos no poder, assim como Nigel Farage, faremos tudo ao nosso alcance para conter a imigração tanto na França quanto na Inglaterra”, afirmou.

item.title: Modric available to play for Croatia in Nations League
item.description: Luka Modric is still available to play for Croatia, the country's soccer association (HNS) said on Saturday, ending speculation that the veteran midfielder would end his international career after this year's World Cup.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Luka Modric is still available to play for Croatia, the country's soccer association (HNS) said on Saturday, ending speculation that the veteran midfielder would end his international career after this year's World Cup. Croatia captain Modric, who turns 41 on Wednesday, has been playing for the national team since 2006, earning over 200 caps and helping them reach the 2018 World Cup final. "Luka's decision makes me extremely happy, we are all aware what he brings to Croatia, both on and off the pitch," said Slaven Bilic, who returned for a second spell as Croatia manager after the team exited this year's World Cup in the round of 32. Modric, who spent the majority of his career at Real Madrid, joined AC Milan last year. Croatia will visit the Czech Republic, host England and play Spain twice in the Nations League between September 26 and October 6.

item.title: Peru declares state of emergency in five high-security prisons to combat criminal gangs
item.description: Peru declared a state of emergency in five high-security prisons on Saturday, allowing police and military forces to take control of the facilities in response to citizens' security concerns, the government said in a decree.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Peru declared a state of emergency in five high-security prisons on Saturday, allowing police and military forces to take control of the facilities in response to citizens' security concerns, the government said in a decree. The 60-day measure was issued by the government of President Keiko Fujimori, who took office in late July, and aims to combat criminal organizations operating from inside prisons toward the outside. The five prisons under the emergency order house around 50% of inmates linked to criminal organizations, the government said. Military and police forces will be authorized to take action to secure the airspace and electromagnetic spectrum immediately surrounding the prisons. Peru's homicide rate rose to 10.7 per 100,000 inhabitants last year, up from 10.1 in 2024, according to official data. The previous Sunday, gunmen disguised as police officers killed four people and kidnapped a mining businessman in the country's north; he was freed hours later after paying a ransom, police said. The government has asked Congress for legislative powers for 120 days to designate criminal organizations as "terrorists," but the opposition has raised objections to the request.

item.title: With ailing Shohei Ohtani questionable, Dodgers forge ahead vs. Nationals
item.description: As Shohei Ohtani moves closer to a possible turn on the injured list, the Los Angeles Dodgers have found ways to win without their superstar.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: As Shohei Ohtani moves closer to a possible turn on the injured list, the Los Angeles Dodgers have found ways to win without their superstar. The Dodgers made it two victories in two games without Ohtani on Friday and might be playing a third in a row when they face the Washington Nationals at home Saturday in the middle contest of a three-game series. Ohtani is day-to-day with a sore left knee, sore right biceps and sore neck, but manager Dave Roberts finally admitted that a stint on the injured list is likely. As Ohtani tried to play with his ailments, he hit .128 (5-for-39) with no home runs and no RBIs over his past 12 games and struck out four times on Wednesday. "No, it's not good to have that version of him," Roberts said. "... In five or six or seven days would the old version, the regular version, the normal version of Shohei be there? ... We don't know that answer. Just to kind of kick the can is an option." Alex Call was used in the designated hitter spot in each of the past two games and had a double with a run scored against his former team in Friday's 5-3 victory. Teoscar Hernandez had a two-run double one game after his two-run double gave the Dodgers a 3-2 walk-off victory over the St. Louis Cardinals. The victory even included a rare home run from Kyle Tucker, his first since Aug. 8 and his third in 67 home games. It was his 12th homer of the season after hitting at least 22 home runs in each of the past five seasons. "We still have (a month) left in the season so just feel good going into the playoffs," Tucker said, while electing to focus on team goals instead of personal ones. "Just build overall momentum as a team and carry that into the playoffs." Los Angeles is set to send right-hander Tyler Glasnow (4-0, 2.79 ERA) for his third start since returning from a back ailment. Against the Detroit Tigers on Sunday, he gave up one run on four hits over seven innings to earn the win in a 6-1 game. In eight career appearances (five starts) against Washington, he is 3-1 with a 5.85 ERA. The Nationals will send right-hander Cade Cavalli (12-5, 3.12) to the mound. He will make his 30th start in the first full season of his career, which has come after he returned from Tommy John surgery last year. Cavalli was locked in last Saturday against the Miami Marlins with four no-hit innings but left the outing when he was hit in the right calf with a comebacker. His first career appearance against the Dodgers was never in question. "I didn't want to risk anything compensating with my upper body and putting my arm in a weird position," Cavalli told reporters. "It just felt a little uncomfortable pushing off. Just being more cautious than anything." The Nationals were without catcher Keibert Ruiz on Friday, two days after he left a game against the Atlanta Braves when he was hit in the catcher's mask by a foul ball. He has passed all concussion tests and might be available to play against his former club Saturday. James Wood continues to deliver against the Dodgers. He hit two doubles Friday, including one in the ninth that got the Nationals within 5-3 and brought the tying run to the plate. Wood now has five home runs, three doubles and 12 RBIs against Los Angeles in 10 career games. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ascending Blue Jays battle Royals, focus on better wild-card positioning
item.description: With three weeks remaining in the regular season, the American League still is taking applications for the third and final wild-card spot.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: With three weeks remaining in the regular season, the American League still is taking applications for the third and final wild-card spot. The Toronto Blue Jays (71-71) continue to assert themselves as a viable candidate heading into the second contest of a three-game set against the host Kansas City Royals (63-79) on Saturday night. With a 9-2 win over Kansas City on Friday, the Blue Jays have won six of their last seven games and have pulled within a game of the Cleveland Guardians for the AL's last postseason spot. Toronto has 26 runs across its last three games. "Our at-bats have definitely been better, and we've gotten some timely hitting," Blue Jays manager John Schneider said. "We got a lot of hits in the month of August as a team. We're doing the little things better. We're playing better defense. We're keeping games where they should be better than we did at the beginning of the year. Max Scherzer (2-7, 6.16 ERA) turned back the clock in his last start. Now, the 42-year-old right-hander will search for consistency. Scherzer threw seven scoreless innings and allowed just one hit on Sunday, striking out a season-high 10 batters and walking one in a 7-0 victory over the Seattle Mariners. "We need these wins right now. To go out there and deliver and get a win feels great," Scherzer said. "We're in the thick of it. We're in the playoff hunt, and you've got to go in with the mentality of winning every single day. The pressure is on. You have to go and do something about it. I love these moments. We're in a fight, and we have to fight all the way until the end." As much as Scherzer is focused on propelling the reigning AL champions to the postseason, his manager can appreciate what the future Hall of Famer is doing in the regular season. Scherzer surpassed Gaylord Perry for ninth place on the all-time MLB strikeout list with 3,535. "It was a pretty remarkable performance with the 10 strikeouts, one hit, and then getting into ninth place all-time in strikeouts is pretty cool to see," Schneider said. "He was dialed in from the very beginning. It was vintage Max." In 26 career starts against Kansas City, Scherzer is 14-7 with a 3.57 ERA. He faced the Royals on Aug. 25, throwing five innings of two-run, four-hit ball while walking five and striking out four in a 5-3 loss. The Royals on Saturday will turn to right-hander Seth Lugo (6-8, 5.03 ERA), who is coming off one of the worst outings of his 388 career appearances. The 36-year-old allowed a career-high nine runs on nine hits across 3 2/3 innings, walking two and striking out two in an 11-1 loss to the Cleveland Guardians on Sunday. "I think his stuff was good; he just wasn't on the plate enough early on," Royals manager Matt Quatraro said. "There were a lot of little moments that compounded to make it not a good outing." In eight career appearances (four starts) against the Blue Jays, Lugo is 4-1 with a 2.40 ERA. He dueled Scherzer two starts ago and hurled five innings, allowing one run on six hits, striking out five and walking one in the 5-3 Kansas City win. --Field Level Media

item.title: Cardinals, scrapping for NL wild card, take on Rockies
item.description: St. Louis was facing a missed opportunity and a tough loss Friday night. The Cardinals' fortunes changed with one swing and they gained ground in the National League wild-card race.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: St. Louis was facing a missed opportunity and a tough loss Friday night. The Cardinals' fortunes changed with one swing and they gained ground in the National League wild-card race. Ivan Herrera's three-run homer in the ninth inning gave St. Louis a 7-6 win over the Colorado Rockies. The Cardinals can make it two in a row when the teams meet again Saturday night in Denver. St. Louis (71-71) sends lefty Matthew Liberatore (5-13, 5.41 ERA) to the mound against Colorado rookie Mason Adams (0-0, 3.00) in the second of the three-game series. The Cardinals moved into a tie with Miami and gained a game on Arizona, both of which lost Friday night. The Diamondbacks are a half-game out of the third and final wild-card berth. Liberatore is aiming for his first win in the second half of the season. His last victory was against the Atlanta Braves on July 11; he is 0-7 in his last eight starts. He finished August 0-5 with a 5.91 ERA in six outings, but in two of those starts he fanned nine batters, including his last one in a loss to Pittsburgh on Sunday. He has faced the Rockies six times in his career -- two of them starts -- and is 0-2 with 6.39 ERA. Liberatore could benefit from the offensive production the Cardinals showed in taking two of three from the Los Angeles Dodgers earlier in the week. They scored 21 runs in the first two games, their highest production in two weeks. "I feel like it just goes to show how capable we are, and just how resilient this team is," St. Louis shortstop Thomas Saggese said. "We can play with anybody, and that's obviously a good sign. A lot of positives to take." Colorado (54-87) is looking for positives in another tough season, and Adams is one of those bright spots. The 26-year-old right-hander was acquired from the Chicago White Sox on Aug. 3 and made his major league debut Aug. 25 at Washington. He allowed one run in four innings in the win over the Nationals but didn't stick around to get the victory. He tossed five solid innings in a 10-inning loss at Atlanta on Saturday. Rockies manager Warren Schaeffer was impressed with Adams in his first two starts. "The poise that he shows on the mound, that's not normal for a young guy to come up and do that," Schaeffer said. "His first two starts, especially on the road in hostile environments, have been very impressive. "He's shown the ability to make in-game adjustments already, which is impressive. Obviously, the physical stuff has been really good, too. His ability to spin the ball has been good as well as his ability to throw his heater where he wants to." Colorado will need strong pitching to avoid a fourth straight 100-loss season. The Rockies have shown improvement, surpassing last season's 43 wins on Aug. 1, and they need to finish 9-12 to break the string of triple-digit losses. --Field Level Media

item.title: Venice film 'Primetime' probes line between news and showbiz
item.description: Venice Film Festival contender "Primetime" explores the blurred boundary between journalism and entertainment, its creators said on Saturday, drawing inspiration from the television world of NBC's "To Catch a Predator".
item.dc:creator: Crispian Balmer
item.content:encoded: [USN:L8N4422FV TEXT:"Venice Film Festival"] contender "Primetime" explores the blurred boundary between journalism and entertainment, its creators said on Saturday, drawing inspiration from the television world of NBC's "To Catch a Predator". Robert Pattinson stars in the film, which is inspired by U.S. presenter Chris Hansen's years hosting the investigative series that confronted suspected paedophiles using decoys, hidden cameras and televised sting operations. Director Lance Oppenheim said he was fascinated by the way the programme mixed real danger with carefully constructed scenarios, where actors pretended to be children to lure male predators into a TV ambush. "They collided with an extremely real, extremely dangerous situation," he told a news conference. "The show itself is stranger than fiction," said Oppenheim, making his narrative feature debut after years as a documentary filmmaker. ACTING CHALLENGES FOR PATTINSON The film shows Hansen's ego-fuelled rise within NBC, while his own personal life appears to fall apart as he himself falls into the cross-hairs of a tabloid journalist. Hansen, who has only seen the trailer, has publicly criticised the film, calling it "totally made up". Pattinson struck a conciliatory tone when asked about the remarks. "Obviously I hope he likes the movie," he said. While stressing that he had not set out to make a film about Hansen himself, Pattinson said the television host had inspired everyone involved. "I just think there was something about the show that was very groundbreaking, kind of breaking the rules of television." Pattinson is also a producer on the project and said he had not originally expected to star in the film, but as the research deepened, he found himself increasingly drawn to the lead role. The actor described mastering Hansen's accent and mannerisms as among the most demanding challenges of his career, crediting Oppenheim with spending years discussing every aspect of the character with him. The film also marks the screen acting debut of Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Phoebe Bridgers, whom Pattinson praised for her ease on set and skill at improvisation. "She was just so relaxed, and I was so impressed," he said. "Primetime" is one of four major films starring Pattinson being released this year, including the summer blockbuster "The Odyssey" and "Dune: Part Three", which comes out later this year. He said he found it invigorating to juggle so many projects but acknowledged it wasn't always easy, joking that traces of Hansen's distinctive voice lingered when he started work on "The Odyssey". "I definitely can hear a little Chris Hansen in 'The Odyssey' when I watch it," he said. "Because (filming) literally started a few hours later." "Primetime" is one of 21 movies competing for Venice's Golden Lion award, which will be presented on September 12.

item.title: Chanceler alemão saúda acordo de recuperação da Volkswagen
item.description: O chanceler alemão Friedrich Merz saudou o acordo de recuperação firmado pelo conselho fiscal da Volkswagen nesta semana, afirmando que o destino da montadora alemã tinha repercussões que iam muito além de sua própria força de trabalho.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O chanceler alemão Friedrich Merz saudou o [USN:L6N44V1F7 TEXT:"acordo de recuperação"] firmado pelo conselho fiscal da Volkswagen nesta semana, afirmando que o destino da montadora alemã tinha repercussões que iam muito além de sua própria força de trabalho. “Essa empresa sustenta pelo menos dez vezes, e provavelmente 12 vezes, mais empregos na indústria de fornecedores na região circundante e além”, disse ele neste sábado em um evento do partido em Hannover.

item.title: Luis Campusano's heroics put Padres in position to claim series from Yankees
item.description: The catcher who many thought played his way out of the San Diego Padres' plans at this time last year put them back in the National League's last wild-card spot on Friday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The catcher who many thought played his way out of the San Diego Padres' plans at this time last year put them back in the National League's last wild-card spot on Friday night. In the strongest game of a bounce-back season, Luis Campusano threw out three would-be base stealers and then belted a game-winning two-run homer in the bottom of the 10th inning to give San Diego a dramatic 3-2 win over the visiting New York Yankees. Campusano and the Padres aim for a series win in a late-afternoon start on Saturday. Few would have dared forecast Campusano playing such a pivotal role in spring training. After hitting 15 homers in 140 games as a part-time starter in 2023 and 2024, Campusano got into just 10 games last year and went hitless in 21 at-bats. But Freddy Fermin, the starter coming into 2026, struggled early and then battled injuries. Campusano, who slugged 25 homers last year at Triple-A El Paso, got back into the lineup and started hitting. Even though he's missed time with injuries this year, Campusano has played his way back into relevance. While the arrival of prospect Ethan Salas from Triple-A might cut into his innings defensively, it frees up Campusano for designated hitter duties. "The biggest thing is he's been able to interact with everyone else and not been so tunnel-visioned," Padres manager Craig Stammen said of Campusano. "He feels like a guy who is valued and has a great place in this organization." Campusano's heroics improved San Diego to 74-67 and gave it a half-game lead on Arizona in the wild-card race. It will try to ride the left arm of Robbie Ray (11-7, 3.14 ERA) to the series win. Ray pitched six good innings Sunday in his team's 5-4, 11-inning loss at Tampa Bay, yielding three hits and a run while walking three and striking out four. Ray is 2-4 with a 3.89 ERA in eight career starts against the Yankees. Fellow left-hander Carlos Rodon (4-3, 3.20) gets the ball for New York for his first start in a week. He suffered a 6-0 loss to Boston on Aug. 29, permitting three hits and two runs in 4 2/3 innings with a walk and five strikeouts. Rodon is 2-2 with a 2.27 ERA in five career outings against the Padres. The Yankees (80-61) lost on two fronts Friday night when Campusano drilled his walkoff homer off Paul Blackburn. They fell four games behind Tampa Bay in the American League East while seeing their lead on Boston for the first wild-card spot drop to 3 ½ games. There was good news for New York. Star right fielder Aaron Judge took batting practice before Friday night's game. Manager Aaron Boone said it's possible that Judge could be activated next week during a homestand against Colorado and the New York Mets. Judge, who's been out with a stress fracture in his first right rib since June 5, would prefer to skip a minor league rehab assignment. "I don't see a point," he said. "Why waste the at-bats?" Judge was batting .248 with 17 homers and 38 RBI before going on the injured list. Depending on the severity of Trent Grisham's hamstring injury that knocked him out of Friday night's game, the Yankees could pivot toward Judge quicker than the anticipated timeline. --Field Level Media

item.title: Cidadão chinês é resgatado de túnel no Nepal dez dias após avalanche
item.description: Um cidadão chinês foi resgatado com vida de um túnel no Nepal neste sábado, informaram as autoridades, dez dias depois que uma avalanche de gelo, rochas e lama varreu um vale no Himalaia, matando mais de 1.300 pessoas.
item.dc:creator: Sahana Bajracharya, Navesh Chitrakar, Joseph Campbell
item.content:encoded: Um cidadão chinês foi resgatado com vida de um túnel no Nepal neste sábado, informaram as autoridades, dez dias depois que uma avalanche de gelo, rochas e lama varreu um vale no Himalaia, matando mais de 1.300 pessoas. O exército nepalês informou que Lu Haitao foi resgatado de dentro de um túnel de 225 metros no Projeto Hidrelétrico Upper Trishuli-1. Ele foi a terceira pessoa, até o momento, a ser resgatada com vida de vários túneis onde as autoridades acreditam que 900 pessoas possam estar presas após o desabamento, em 26 de agosto, de uma geleira na parte superior de um rio. Na sexta-feira, equipes de resgate retiraram duas pessoas de outro túnel na Usina Hidrelétrica Upper Trishuli 3A, no mesmo rio. As autoridades informaram que Lu não apresentava ferimentos visíveis e que seus sinais vitais estavam estáveis, mas que ele apresentava sinais de hipotermia leve. Imagens divulgadas pelo exército nepalês mostraram ele recebendo atendimento médico de emergência dentro de um helicóptero, no caminho para um hospital do exército. Ele parecia exausto e desorientado, com lama seca e poeira na pele e nas roupas. Um médico uniformizado, com um estetoscópio, foi visto examinando o homem. Pelo menos 1.344 pessoas morreram no Nepal nas enchentes que arrasaram casas, ruas e escolas em cidades e vilarejos próximos à fronteira com o Tibete, na China, informou a autoridade de gestão de desastres na sexta-feira. Cerca de 4.887 pessoas continuam desaparecidas, incluindo 583 estrangeiros, muitos deles peregrinos e alpinistas. Até sexta-feira, a China informou que o número de mortos no Tibete era de 31, com outras 531 pessoas listadas como desaparecidas, incluindo estrangeiros, segundo a agência de notícias estatal Xinhua. Cerca de 261 estrangeiros continuam desaparecidos no Tibete. Uma mulher, Chandika Kumari Shrestha, também foi resgatada de sua casa em Betrawati neste sábado, informou o exército nepalês. Em uma imagem compartilhada pelas autoridades, ela é vista coberta de lama dentro de uma estrutura subterrânea alagada, enquanto equipes de resgate lhe oferecem água ao trabalhar em um espaço confinado cheio de lodo espesso.

item.title: Enviados dos EUA chegam a Moscou para conversas sobre paz na Ucrânia
item.description: Os representantes especiais dos EUA, Steve Witkoff e Jared Kushner, chegaram a Moscou neste sábado para conversas que buscam dar fim à guerra na Ucrânia.
item.dc:creator: Gleb Bryanski
item.content:encoded: Os representantes especiais dos EUA, Steve Witkoff e Jared Kushner, chegaram a Moscou neste sábado para conversas que buscam dar fim à guerra na Ucrânia. Eles foram recebidos pelo enviado presidencial russo Kirill Dmitriev. Uma comitiva transportando Witkoff, Kushner e Dmitriev partiu do aeroporto governamental de Moscou e seguiu em direção à cidade, segundo uma testemunha da Reuters. O porta-voz russo, Dmitry Peskov, disse à agência de notícias TASS que o presidente Vladimir Putin se reuniria com Witkoff e Kushner no Kremlin ainda neste sábado. O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, sugeriu na sexta-feira que os EUA tinham uma nova proposta concreta com o objetivo de pôr fim à guerra, que já está em seu quinto ano. Ele não deu, no entanto, mais detalhes sobre a proposta. O enviado russo Dmitriev, que disse à Reuters em junho que havia permanecido em contato com os negociadores norte-americanos durante uma pausa em suas visitas à Rússia, participou de todas as reuniões anteriores com Putin ao lado do assessor de política externa do presidente russo, Yuri Ushakov. Ele também desempenhou um papel nas negociações para a isenção das sanções dos EUA ao petróleo russo neste ano. O presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy disse na sexta-feira que os dois enviados norte-americanos voariam para a Ucrânia no domingo, após visitarem Moscou. Em uma postagem no X neste sábado, Zelenskiy afirmou que a Rússia atacou dois aeroportos ucranianos antes da visita dos enviados dos EUA a Kiev. Peskov disse em um comunicado publicado no canal do Kremlin no aplicativo de mensagens Max que Putin havia ordenado às forças armadas que não atacassem Kiev por três dias, a partir da meia-noite de sábado, em função da visita de Witkoff e Kushner à capital ucraniana. ABISMO ENTRE POSIÇÕES O Ministério da Defesa russo registrou 53 drones ucranianos no espaço aéreo russo neste sábado, um número significativamente menor do que a média observada nos últimos meses. Moscou comemora o Dia da Cidade neste sábado, com centenas de milhares de pessoas participando de festividades ao ar livre. No entanto, permanece um grande abismo entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia sobre como encerrar a guerra que já dura quatro anos e meio. Uma fonte próxima ao Kremlin, falando antes que surgissem relatos sobre uma possível viagem dos enviados do presidente Trump, disse que Putin ainda está decidido a conquistar mais território. “Não há chance de se chegar a um acordo sobre a linha de frente até que Putin termine de garantir o controle da parte restante da região de Donetsk”, disse a fonte à Reuters, acrescentando que o líder do Kremlin estava confiante -- com base em relatórios de seus comandantes -- de que isso aconteceria até o final do ano.

item.title: Homens mascarados protestam em porto inglês de Dover e interrompem tráfego com a França
item.description: Protestos realizados por grupos de homens mascarados nas estradas ao redor do porto inglês de Dover, principal ponto de passagem das balsas com destino à França, interromperam o tráfego neste sábado, segundo a polícia e as autoridades portuárias.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Protestos realizados por grupos de homens mascarados nas estradas ao redor do porto inglês de Dover, principal ponto de passagem das balsas com destino à França, interromperam o tráfego neste sábado, segundo a polícia e as autoridades portuárias. Os manifestantes, vestidos de preto e usando balaclavas, gritavam “Parem os barcos”, informou a BBC, em referência aos requerentes de asilo que chegam à costa sul da Inglaterra vindos da França. As principais vias de acesso ao porto foram bloqueadas na manhã deste sábado, mas o acesso ao porto já havia sido restabelecido e os participantes do “protesto espontâneo” haviam se dispersado por volta do meio-dia (horário local), informou a Polícia de Kent em comunicado divulgado na rede social X. Nenhuma prisão foi realizada, informou a polícia. Sucessivos governos britânicos têm enfrentado dificuldades para conter o fluxo de requerentes de asilo, que muitas vezes chegam em barcos infláveis superlotados. No entanto, o número de chegadas neste ano até 1º de setembro foi de 16.513, cerca de 43% menor do que no mesmo período de 2025, segundo dados do governo citados pela BBC.

item.title: Astros' pitching trending up as series with D-backs continues
item.description: Two nights after Hayden Wesneski continued what has been a remarkably smooth return from Tommy John surgery, Cristian Javier matched his season high in strikeouts and gave the Houston Astros more confidence that their rotation is rounding into form.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Two nights after Hayden Wesneski continued what has been a remarkably smooth return from Tommy John surgery, Cristian Javier matched his season high in strikeouts and gave the Houston Astros more confidence that their rotation is rounding into form. Javier recorded eight strikeouts over five innings Friday to help lift the Astros (73-69) to a 3-1 victory against the Arizona Diamondbacks (74-68). The second contest of the three-game interleague series is Saturday. While Wesneski lowered his ERA to 0.53 over his last three starts, Javier increased his strikeout total to 20 over his last 13 1/3 innings and three outings. "I really think he's getting to that point where we can see that version that we've seen in the past from Javi," Astros manager Joe Espada said. "The plan was, let's give him five (innings), 80, 85 (pitches), and that was the game plan, and he did a nice job. But the plan moving forward is: Can we see more? That was a really good version of Javi." With Wesneski displaying fine form despite making only seven starts this season, the Astros are confident that he can slot behind ace Hunter Brown and Peter Lambert in their rotation down the stretch. How the remaining rotation options pitch could determine the Astros' postseason odds. "They want to be part of it, and they're part of it," Espada said. "But now we need that extra push to really protect our bullpen and get some quality outings from those guys." Rookie right-hander Ethan Pecko (1-0, 6.23 ERA) is scheduled to start for the Astros on Saturday. Pecko notched his first career victory Sunday against the New York Mets, allowing three runs (two earned) on three hits and two walks while striking out four over five innings in a 6-3 win. He made his big-league debut against the Los Angeles Angels on Aug. 19. Pecko will make his first career start against the Diamondbacks and his second straight interleague start. Right-hander Brandon Pfaadt (7-2, 3.49) has the starting assignment for the Diamondbacks. He is winless over his last three starts (0-1, 5.40 ERA) after allowing two runs on five hits and one walk with one strikeout in a 2-1 loss to the Philadelphia Phillies on Monday. Pfaadt had recorded seven consecutive winning decisions across his previous nine starts, posting a 1.15 ERA. Pfaadt is 0-1 with a 5.40 ERA in two career starts against the Astros. In his previous start against Houston, he allowed two runs on five hits and two walks with five strikeouts over 5 1/3 innings in the Diamondbacks' 4-3 home loss on July 23, 2025. Right-hander Corbin Burnes appears poised to rejoin the Arizona rotation, perhaps as early as Tuesday against the Kansas City Royals, completing a protracted return from Tommy John surgery. Burnes last started for the Diamondbacks on June 1, 2025, before undergoing surgery. Burnes could be limited to 60 pitches should he make his debut against the Royals. Given the depth of the Arizona bullpen, such a limitation wouldn't be prohibitive. "Beyond that, we feel like we have enough pieces in our bullpen," Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo said. "We've got 10-11 guys in there right now, and if there's availability in our bullpen with our plus relievers, Corbin gives us four or five innings, we can start to stand on it and win the game with our best pieces." --Field Level Media

item.title: Hombres enmascarados se manifiestan en puerto inglés de Dover, interrumpe tráfico a través del Canal de la Mancha
item.description: Las protestas de grupos de hombres enmascarados en las carreteras de los alrededores del puerto inglés de Dover, principal centro de conexión de los transbordadores que cruzan a Francia, interrumpieron el tráfico el sábado, según informaron la policía y las autoridades portuarias.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las protestas de grupos de hombres enmascarados en las carreteras de los alrededores del puerto inglés de Dover, principal centro de conexión de los transbordadores que cruzan a Francia, interrumpieron el tráfico el sábado, según informaron la policía y las autoridades portuarias. Los manifestantes, vestidos de negro y con pasamontañas, coreaban «Stop the boats» («Detengan los barcos»), según informó la BBC, en referencia a los solicitantes de asilo que llegan a la costa sur de Inglaterra desde Francia. Las principales carreteras de acceso al puerto quedaron bloqueadas el sábado por la mañana, pero el acceso al puerto se había restablecido y los participantes en la "protesta espontánea" se habían dispersado a mediodía, según informó la Policía de Kent en un comunicado el X. No se produjeron detenciones, según la policía. Los sucesivos gobiernos británicos han tenido dificultades para frenar el flujo de solicitantes de asilo, que a menudo llegan en embarcaciones neumáticas abarrotadas. Sin embargo, el número de llegadas este año hasta el 1 de septiembre ascendió a 16.513, lo que supone un descenso de alrededor del 43% respecto al mismo periodo de 2025, según datos del Gobierno citados por la BBC.

item.title: Enviados EEUU Witkoff y Kushner llegan a Moscú para mantener conversaciones sobre paz en Ucrania
item.description: Los representantes especiales de Estados Unidos, Steve Witkoff y Jared Kushner, aterrizaron el sábado en Moscú para mantener conversaciones sobre cómo poner fin a la guerra en Ucrania, donde fueron recibidos por el enviado presidencial ruso Kirill Dmitriev.
item.dc:creator: Gleb Bryanski
item.content:encoded: Los representantes especiales de Estados Unidos, Steve Witkoff y Jared Kushner, aterrizaron el sábado en Moscú para mantener conversaciones sobre cómo poner fin a la guerra en Ucrania, donde fueron recibidos por el enviado presidencial ruso Kirill Dmitriev. Una comitiva, en la que viajaban Witkoff, Kushner y Dmitriev, partió del aeropuerto gubernamental de Moscú y se dirigió hacia la ciudad, según informó un testigo de Reuters. El portavoz ruso, Dmitry Peskov, declaró a la agencia de noticias TASS que el presidente Vladimir Putin se reuniría con Witkoff y Kushner en el Kremlin más tarde ese mismo sábado. El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, sugirió el viernes que Washington tenía una nueva propuesta concreta destinada a poner fin a la guerra, que ya cumple su quinto año. Sin embargo, no dio más detalles sobre en qué consistiría dicha propuesta. El enviado ruso Dmitriev, quien declaró a Reuters en junio que se había mantenido en contacto con los negociadores estadounidenses durante una pausa en sus visitas a Rusia, participó en todas sus reuniones anteriores con Putin junto al asesor de política exterior de este, Yuri Ushakov. También desempeñó un papel en la negociación de las exenciones a las sanciones estadounidenses sobre el petróleo ruso este año. El presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, afirmó el viernes que ambos viajarían a Ucrania el domingo tras visitar Moscú. En una publicación en X el sábado, Zelenskiy señaló que Rusia había atacado dos aeropuertos ucranianos antes de la visita de los enviados estadounidenses a Kiev. Peskov afirmó en un comunicado publicado en el canal del Kremlin en la aplicación de mensajería Max que Putin había ordenado al ejército no atacar Kiev durante tres días, a partir de la medianoche del sábado, en relación con la visita de Witkoff y Kushner a la capital ucraniana. El Ministerio de Defensa ruso informó el sábado de la presencia de 53 drones ucranianos en el espacio aéreo ruso, una cifra significativamente inferior a la media registrada en los últimos meses. Moscú celebra este sábado el Día de la Ciudad, con cientos de miles de personas participando en las festividades al aire libre por toda la ciudad. Sigue existiendo una enorme brecha entre Rusia y Ucrania sobre cómo poner fin a la guerra, que ya dura cuatro años y medio y es la más mortífera en Europa desde la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Una fuente cercana al Kremlin, que habló antes de que surgieran las noticias sobre un posible viaje de los enviados del presidente Trump, afirmó que Putin seguía decidido a conquistar más territorio. "No hay posibilidad de alcanzar un acuerdo sobre la línea del frente hasta que Putin termine de asegurar la parte restante de la región de Donetsk", declaró la fuente a Reuters, añadiendo que el líder del Kremlin confiaba —basándose en los informes de sus comandantes— en que esto ocurriría antes de que acabara el año.

item.title: Pursuing playoffs, Rangers turn to Jacob deGrom to try to shut down Rays
item.description: The Texas Rangers hope the "vintage" Jacob deGrom returns for his next start on Saturday evening against the Tampa Bay Rays.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Texas Rangers hope the "vintage" Jacob deGrom returns for his next start on Saturday evening against the Tampa Bay Rays. The 38-year-old deGrom (10-9, 4.00 ERA) is scheduled to start in the third game of a four-game series in Arlington, Texas, five days after the two-time National League Cy Young Award winner pitched one of the best games of his career. The Rangers and Rays have split the first two games of the series. deGrom allowed one hit and faced the minimum of 21 batters over seven innings in an 8-1 win against the visiting Athletics on Monday, becoming the first Rangers pitcher to face the minimum through seven innings since Jon Gray on June 7, 2023, against the St. Louis Cardinals. "That was vintage deGrom tonight," A's manager Mark Kotsay said. "He had his explosive fastball. The slider was anywhere from 94 (mph). I saw one against (Jeff) McNeil that just turned left. I thought he was probably at his best tonight." It marked the eighth time this season that the right-hander didn't issue a walk, and the third outing in which he surrendered just one hit. "It's special watching him cruise like that," Rangers first baseman Jake Burger said. "That's why he's one of the greats." The Rangers (70-72) sensed something special was brewing with deGrom after he surrendered eight runs in 3 2/3 innings in his previous start Aug. 25 against the Chicago White Sox, an outing that led to an 11-7 loss. "I'm pretty frustrated after most rough starts, but that one was really bad," deGrom said. "We can't afford to have those kinds of starts. That really bothered me. We needed to go out there and win games there, and I had an absolute terrible start. I needed to turn the page and prepare for this one. Hopefully, moving forward, I can continue to throw the ball how I expect to." Texas manager Skip Schumaker said he would like to see more consistency from deGrom, as well, as the Rangers chase a playoff berth. Texas stands three games out of first place in the American League West, behind the Houston Astros, and two games out of the AL's final wild-card spot. "There's been some really good starts, and then there's been some ones that he would tell you that have not been so great," Schumaker said. "After the last one, I felt like (against the A's) was going to be a really good day, just because he was so mad at what happened. "When you have a competitor like Jacob, who is pretty upset at the previous game or previous start, you knew that he was going to come in with a different type of mentality and be on the attack. And that's exactly what he did." The Rays (84-57) are one of the few MLB teams deGrom has not defeated in his career. He's 0-1 in four starts with a 3.00 ERA against them. Tampa Bay, which has the best record in the AL, plans to start right-hander Drew Rasmussen (14-5, 2.95 ERA) on Saturday. He went 5-0 in six starts in August while posting a 2.57 ERA. Rasmussen's most recent start last Sunday is the only one in which he did not earn a victory last month. He allowed two runs and four hits in six innings of a 5-4 win against the San Diego Padres in 11 innings, helping his team complete a sweep. "This is a series we can point to and tell our guys who haven't experienced postseason baseball, 'Every day is like this,'" Rasmussen said. "It's a roller-coaster ride. Games are close, and you win on the margins." Rasmussen has made three starts in his career against the Rangers, going 1-1 with a 4.15 ERA. He most recently faced them on June 3, 2025, and threw five shutout innings in a 5-1 victory. --Field Level Media

item.title: US military strikes three Iranian crude oil carriers, Central Command says
item.description: The strike came after Iran launched ballistic missiles at two U.S. Navy ships, it said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: American forces struck three Iranian crude oil tankers on Saturday after Iran launched ballistic missiles at two U.S. Navy ships, U.S. Central Command said. No American personnel were harmed, Central Command said.

item.title: Ciudadano chino es rescatado de un túnel en Nepal diez días después de una crecida repentina
item.description: Las autoridades informaron que el sábado se rescató con vida a un ciudadano chino de un túnel en Nepal, diez días después de que una avalancha de hielo, rocas y barro arrasara un valle del Himalaya, causando la muerte de más de 1.300 personas.
item.dc:creator: Sahana Bajracharya, Navesh Chitrakar, Joseph Campbell
item.content:encoded: Las autoridades informaron que el sábado se rescató con vida a un ciudadano chino de un túnel en Nepal, diez días después de que una avalancha de hielo, rocas y barro arrasara un valle del Himalaya, causando la muerte de más de 1.300 personas. El ejército nepalí informó de que Lu Haitao fue rescatado del interior de un túnel de 225 metros en el proyecto hidroeléctrico Upper Trishuli-1. Se trata de la tercera persona rescatada con vida hasta la fecha de los distintos túneles en los que las autoridades creen que podrían quedar atrapadas 900 personas tras el desprendimiento de un glaciar ocurrido el 26 de agosto en la cuenca alta del río. El viernes, los equipos de rescate sacaron a dos personas de otro túnel de la central hidroeléctrica Upper Trishuli 3A, situada en el mismo río. Las autoridades indicaron que Lu no presentaba lesiones visibles y que sus signos vitales eran estables, aunque mostraba síntomas de hipotermia leve. Las imágenes difundidas por el ejército nepalí mostraban cómo recibía atención médica de urgencia dentro de un helicóptero, que lo trasladó a un hospital militar. Parecía agotado y desorientado, con barro seco y polvo en la piel y la ropa. Se vio a un médico uniformado con un estetoscopio examinándolo. Al menos 1.344 personas han perdido la vida en Nepal a causa de las inundaciones que arrasaron casas, calles y colegios en pueblos y aldeas cercanas a la frontera con el Tíbet chino, según informó el viernes la autoridad de gestión de catástrofes. Unas 4.887 personas siguen desaparecidas, entre ellas 583 ciudadanos extranjeros, muchos de ellos peregrinos y excursionistas. Hasta el viernes, China había informado de que el número de fallecidos en el Tíbet ascendía a 31, con otros 531 desaparecidos, incluidos ciudadanos extranjeros, según la agencia estatal de noticias Xinhua. Unos 261 ciudadanos extranjeros siguen desaparecidos en el Tíbet. El ejército nepalí informó de que el sábado también se rescató a una mujer, Chandika Kumari Shrestha, de su casa en Betrawati. En una imagen difundida por las autoridades, se la ve cubierta de barro en el interior de una estructura subterránea inundada, mientras los equipos de rescate le ofrecen agua y trabajan en un espacio reducido lleno de lodo espeso.

item.title: Russian Valieva's neutral athlete status revoked, source says
item.description: Russian figure skater Kamila Valieva will not be able to compete internationally after the sport's ruling body revoked her neutral athlete status, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Tommy Lund
item.content:encoded: Russian figure skater Kamila Valieva will not be able to compete internationally after the sport's ruling body revoked her neutral athlete status, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Saturday. Valieva, 20, was 15 when she became the centre of a global controversy at the 2022 Olympics, after a sample taken two months earlier tested positive for the banned substance trimetazidine. She has received a letter informing her of the International Skating Union's (ISU) decision to revoke her neutral status, the source said. The ISU declined to comment. Valieva's representatives were not immediately available for comment. The Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) imposed a four-year ban on Valieva in 2024, with the penalty backdated to when she tested positive for trimetazidine, which prevents angina attacks, at the Russian national championships in December 2021. The failed test emerged after she had helped Russia win team gold at the Olympics, a result which was later annulled, elevating the United States to the top of the podium. Valieva [USN:L8N3YX0EM TEXT:"returned "]to ice skating in February at the Russian Jumping Championships but remained ineligible for this year's Milano-Cortina Olympics. Russian athletes have been barred from competing under their national flags since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine. The ISU has established a pathway for select athletes to compete as individual neutral athletes subject to rigorous vetting. Russian athletes can compete as neutrals if they pass strict background checks. Without neutral status, skaters cannot enter ISU events, earn world ranking points or compete for global titles.
